**2026-11-15** — Trial 3 result, 2026-11-14/15, S248, run ork-20261114-224559-2b00 (claude-local qwen3.8-27b low implementer; S360, S358, S356 live): fail, stopped at the 90 min limit (22:46-00:16) with no product edits and no report. | launcher | role | result | rounds | time | findings missed | — | claude-local qwen3.8-27b | implementer | fail: 90 min, no edits | 1 | 90 min | n/a |. Fresh sessions worked as built: 8 sessions, 7 restarts at 70.4k-75.2k tokens, no auto-compaction (trial 2 lost 50 min to three). Reads were targeted: every Read had a limit (12-220 lines), about 20 Reads and 5-14 Greps per session. But each session spent its whole window re-reading the same files (wire.go, handlers.go, daemoncmds.go, cli.go, daemon_test.go) and restarted before its first edit; the progress note was written once (session 6) and only said 'fresh session, nothing survived'. Permission questions: 3 (two ls on own files, one 'go -C WT grep', not a go command), all allowed. Denials: 2, both a Read of the not-yet-written progress note: the hook denies a Read of a missing file ('cannot count Read lines: stat ... no such file'). Because the run had denials, the sonnet fallback did not take over (round.go:657 fallingBack needs no denials) and the run stopped. Finding: with ~26k fixed context, a 70k window leaves ~44k, too little to load the 5-6 files S248 touches and still edit; the fresh-session loop re-explores instead of progressing unless the role saves progress. Candidates: sliver first (S359, waits on S62), a cloud-written orientation pack (exact anchors and the plan) in the brief, or a larger window now that compaction is gone. No default role changed.

## Why

- The owner wants the matrix tuned by evidence, not by guess: local rows start size S and well specified (owner, 2026-11-07), and the rest is open.
- The local server is weaker and slower than the cloud models, handles about 2 to 4 concurrent requests (owner estimate), and serves one model at a time.

## Implement

1. With the owner, choose a fixed set of small slices of known difficulty and run each role (implementer, reviewer, gate, spec check, UI pass) on each local launcher through a per-run lineup override.
2. Record, per role and launcher: pass or fail, rounds used, time, and findings missed against a cloud review of the same diff.
3. Propose matrix rows and conditions from the record; the owner decides them (adj record).
4. Do not change a default role to local without an owner decision (adj 181).
